themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep taking listed businesses off public markets. Ithaca Holdings will pay $6.05 a share in cash, about $1.3bn and a ~138% premium, to take Bumble private (bmbl-ithaca-take-private). CD&R (51%) and McKesson (49%) will pay $32.05 a share, about $5.8bn including debt, for home-infusion provider Option Care Health (opch-cdr-mckesson-take-private). Viatris is tendering $36.50 a share in cash, about $1.65bn, for Pacira BioSciences, with closing by year-end (pcrx-viatris-acquisition). Authentic Brands has privately discussed buying Mattel at more than $20 a share with no formal sale process (mat-authentic-brands-takeover-approach). Tender mechanics are the risk: Copart's HSR waiting period for ACV has now expired, leaving only the minimum-tender condition before its 15 October expiry (cprt-acv-acquisition), and Curaleaf has raised its hostile Aurora Cannabis bid to an implied US$5.00 with expiry pushed to 4 December (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid). Peel has already declared its offer for Harworth unconditional (hwg-peel-acquisition).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep being resolved by regulators, politicians and courts rather than by the parties. Paramount's ~$110bn Warner Bros. Discovery takeover closed on 6 October only after a 12-state antitrust suit was settled with a five-year court-enforceable behavioural package (psky-wbd-acquisition). Kimberly-Clark won EU clearance for Kenvue only by agreeing to sell its EEA feminine-care brands, and China's in-depth review still stands in the way (kmb-kenvue-acquisition). AkzoNobel and Axalta are expected to buy EU clearance for their $25bn merger by offering to sell a vehicle-refinish business (akza-axalta-merger). BT's rescue of TalkTalk waits on a CMA report due 19 October and a public-interest decision by the Culture Secretary (bt-talktalk-acquisition). The clean exits show the contrast: Brazil's CADE cleared Transocean-Valaris without restrictions, completing its approvals (val-transocean-acquisition), and Copart's refiled HSR waiting period for ACV lapsed with no second request (cprt-acv-acquisition); in Canada both Curaleaf and Aurora have drafted the Alberta Securities Commission into their fight (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with cash coming in faster than they can reinvest it keep expanding share repurchases, each tying the bigger programme to a specific cash or capital tailwind. Nvidia added $150bn to its authorization on AI-accelerator cash flow (nvda-buyback-2026). TotalEnergies lifted Q4 buybacks to $2.5bn and pledged more than 5% annual dividend growth as oil trades around $100 (tte-buyback-dividend-2026). Canadian banks are moving together: TD has OSFI approval and began buying back up to another C$10bn on 9 October (td-buyback-2026), and Scotiabank lifted its issuer bid to 40 million shares (bns-buyback-2026). Julius Baer announced a CHF600m buyback days after FINMA closed its Signa probe (baer-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large incumbents are bidding for same-country or same-sector rivals to get the scale to compete with US and Chinese peers, and in each case the target's controlling shareholders decide the outcome. Intesa Sanpaolo has sweetened its offer for Monte dei Paschi and secured Delfin's backing, but the MPS board says the premium is still too low and is sticking with its own plan ahead of a 29 October vote (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Evonik rejected BASF's approach, and RAG-Stiftung's roughly 43% stake decides what happens next (evk-basf-acquisition). KKR and RWE have bid together for state-owned Uniper (un01-rwe-kkr-acquisition), though Apollo has submitted its own non-binding bid alongside EPH, Brookfield/CPP and Equinor (un01-apollo-acquisition). RHI Magnesita faces a 27 October put-up-or-shut-up deadline for Vesuvius (vsvs-rhim-takeover-proposal).

themes.label: Governments selling state-held stakes to strategic and financial buyers
themes.note: Several governments are privatising long-held stakes and choosing buyers on price plus industrial plan. India's cabinet approved selling 60.72% of IDBI Bank (government and LIC) to Fairfax for ₹52,878 crore, keeping 34% between them (ffh-idbi-bank-acquisition). Portugal picked Lufthansa's all-cash offer for 44.9% of TAP Air Portugal over Air France-KLM while keeping a 50.1% majority (lha-tap-stake-acquisition). Germany is selling up to 74.12% of Uniper to meet EU rules, drawing a KKR-RWE joint bid (un01-rwe-kkr-acquisition) and a separate Apollo bid (un01-apollo-acquisition).
